itemized.notes: This filing is NOT the handwritten paper form - it is the clerk's web-printed 'summary_printer.cfm?ID=818' variant (printed 9/14/2012), which prints the Summary and BOTH itemized tables as typed HTML tables. Consequences: (1) the itemized tables have NO address column at all, so donor_city/donor_state are blank for every row - that is form-variant non-existence, not a redaction and not a filer omission; only the CANDIDATE's own address block on p1 is county-redacted (black bar). (2) There is an explicit 'In-Kind?' column, so in_kind is source-marked rather than inferred. (3) The tables carry their own printed totals rather than per-page SUBTOTAL lines. The $917.27 Salt Lake County Republican Party item appears on BOTH sides as a matched in-kind pair (received and expended), and both printed totals include it - consistent with the brief's rule that in-kind rows count toward this form's printed totals. Footer states 'No Contributions Received from other Campaign Accounts reported for this period' and likewise for expenditures; Summary columns C/D (Other Campaign Accounts) are $0.00.
